title: Raku Firing Workshop
evidence_sentence: The glaze and firing classes page lists a raku firing workshop with dates announced later in 2026.
summary: A day workshop where you glaze bisque-fired pieces and fire them in a raku kiln, using crackle glazes supplied by the studio or your own additional raku glazes, horsehair, and combustibles.
how_to_join: Register at the Square link on the Glaze & Firing Classes page when dates are posted.
commitment: One day, approximately 9am until firing complete
bring: 4 bisque-fired pieces (no bowls or plates); optional raku glazes, horsehair, or combustibles for surface design
